name: factoholic-script-engine
description: Local reference search, transcript reading, and script workflow for GeoAxis.
long_description: A local-first MCP server for an operator-selected transcript folder. The corpus is not included in this bundle. It uses a local SQLite index, exposes evidence and workflow tools, and does not call an external model API.

tools.name: get_instructions
tools.description: Load the current editable Master Instructions and content hash.

tools.name: get_workflow_contract
tools.description: Read the technical workflow contract.

tools.name: get_dataset_overview
tools.description: Report corpus file counts, parse status, and coverage.

tools.name: refresh_dataset_index
tools.description: Incrementally index added or modified Markdown transcripts.

tools.name: search_references
tools.description: Search the full indexed transcript corpus with filters and pagination.

tools.name: read_transcript
tools.description: Read a complete indexed Markdown transcript with paging.

tools.name: get_script_dna
tools.description: Return existing analysis separately from caption evidence.

tools.name: search_language_patterns
tools.description: Search real caption lines for language evidence.

tools.name: search_humor_patterns
tools.description: Search caption evidence only for creator-attributed humor references.

tools.name: save_reference_analysis
tools.description: Store analysis after exact caption evidence checks.

tools.name: get_language_bank
tools.description: Retrieve evidence-matched language patterns with provenance.

tools.name: start_corpus_learning_batch
tools.description: Start a fresh full-corpus cycle for an outline or script request.

tools.name: get_corpus_learning_status
tools.description: Report delivery, AI inspection, analysis, validation, pending and failure counts separately.

tools.name: get_next_corpus_learning_batch
tools.description: Deliver actual transcript contents in a resumable context-limited batch.

tools.name: pause_corpus_learning_batch
tools.description: Checkpoint an active full-corpus reading cycle.

tools.name: resume_corpus_learning_batch
tools.description: Resume a paused full-corpus reading cycle.

tools.name: submit_corpus_learning_analysis
tools.description: Submit connected-AI topic-specific semantic observations and evidence-backed patterns.

tools.name: validate_corpus_learning_analysis
tools.description: Validate submitted learning evidence against source captions.

tools.name: search_corpus_learning
tools.description: Search validated language, humor, construction, explanation and storytelling banks independently.

tools.name: validate_reference_evidence
tools.description: Validate source IDs, exact quotes, timestamps, and duplicates.

tools.name: create_session
tools.description: Start a persistent, isolated workflow and retrieve current instructions.

tools.name: get_session_context
tools.description: Resume a workflow with its references, contexts, and saved artifacts.

tools.name: update_session_context
tools.description: Persist research, mapping, language, humor, prompt, and audit context.

tools.name: refresh_session_instructions
tools.description: Reload changed instructions and acknowledge their current hash.

tools.name: save_outline
tools.description: Save a requested outline in pending approval state.

tools.name: approve_outline
tools.description: Explicitly approve a saved outline.

tools.name: get_approved_outline
tools.description: Retrieve approved outline content for its session.

tools.name: save_script
tools.description: Save a requested script after deterministic evidence and duration checks.

tools.name: validate_script
tools.description: Check evidence, word count, duration estimate, and workflow consistency.

tools.name: get_audit_report
tools.description: Report actual source coverage, version status, artifacts, and limitations.

dataset_dir.title: Transcript folder
dataset_dir.description: Choose the local folder containing the original Markdown transcripts. The files stay outside this bundle and are not modified.

state_dir.title: Local database folder
state_dir.description: Folder for the local SQLite index and workflow sessions.

instructions_file.title: Master Instructions file
instructions_file.description: Editable local Master Instructions file. The server reloads it and tracks its SHA-256 hash.

dataset_creator.title: Verified dataset creator (optional)
dataset_creator.description: Set only after confirming the provenance of every file whose missing creator metadata this attribution will cover. Needed to search humor references as FactoHolic when file metadata has no creator field.
